name: All systems MUST comply with the requirements stipulated in our Continuous Assurance platform to ensure a minimum baseline of security hardening is applied.
requirementTitle: All systems MUST comply with the requirements stipulated in our Continuous Assurance platform to ensure a minimum baseline of security hardening is applied.
requirementDescription: Every system must meet the security requirements and checks defined by the organisation's Continuous Assurance platform. The platform is used to continuously verify that systems meet a minimum security standard and remain securely configured over time
why: The platform continuously checks that a minimum set of security hardening controls remain in place, helping to detect configuration weaknesses and compliance issues before they become security incidents.
